text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired — service=/v1/generate, metric=p99_latency, value=3.1s (>2.5s threshold) over 5m. Alert id PD-9876. Auto-coalesce=3.

devin: acked — oncall here, I'm looking. :hand:

incident-bot: Pager assigned to devin (rotation). Context: increased tail latency in eu-west, small spike across batcher.

maya: seeing p99 ~3.1s in eu-west, p95 still ~220ms. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/latency?region=eu-west

devin: checking KV cache hitrate and batcher queue. rolling restart sidecar on two hosts now. CMD: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/sidecar -n inference`

ops-sre: autoscaler shows queue depth rising; current replicas 4 -> scaling target 8, target-ttl=60s. K8s events show short preemptions on GPU nodes.

devin: restarted sidecar on node-a and node-b, batcher backlog dropped ~40% on those pods. heap/threads look normal.

maya: can we divert some traffic to the dedicated pool for eu-west while we stabilize? router supports weight shifts.

devin: initiating a controlled routing weight shift: 20% -> dedicated-pool (dry-run then apply). CLI: `route set --service inference --dest dedicated-pool --weight 0.2`

elena-cs: CS is seeing an uptick in support mentions about "slow responses" from EU customers, not yet high severity but monitoring. Preparing a short customer note if it persists.

status-bot: Created incident INC-2026; customer-impact: "elevated response latency for EU region, degraded API performance". Owner: devin.

maya: after 20% weight shift p99 dropped to ~1.9s, p95 unchanged. Good signal — keep observing for 10m.

devin: will continue rolling restarts on remaining sidecar pods and watch queue depth. If stable after 15m I'll clear PD.

incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-9876 auto-resolved (metrics below threshold for 7m). Please confirm before closing.

devin: confirmed resolved from oncall side. Reverting temporary route change now and monitoring. I'll file a follow-up postmortem. :thumbsup:

elena-cs: posting status update: "Improved latency observed; team continuing to monitor. No action required from customers."

maya: note for postmortem: investigate batcher hysteresis and coalescing thresholds; saw an ack-gap where incident-bot auto-resolved but some PD notifications still fired/weren't acknowledged promptly — potential dup/merge timing issue.

devin: noted. tagging ops-sre and eng-runtime for followup. Closing this thread for urgent ops; monitoring window 30m.
